item: Off-site hold: a source whose recent pages come from one other site is held visibly; its off-site articles are reversibly quarantined (R728 A+B)
refs: PR pending; R728 A B; field test 2026-11-14 report 5.1
key_paths: src/catalog/off_site.py; src/catalog/qualification.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/api/quarantine.py; src/api/source_io.py; src/static/app-sources.js
summary: The 8-instance field test found pakembassykabul.org answering (after redirects) with a casino site while still counted as qualified. Now: when at least 10 of a source's newest 20 articles have a known fetched host and ONE other registrable site (app PSL, IDNA) answers half or more of them, the source is held: an append-only disqualified attempt (oo-off-site-hold-1), status disqualified, stamp cleared, nothing deleted. Only its articles on that other site get the reversible quarantine mark host:off_site, which keeps them out of keyword aggregates (R101); an article already quarantined keeps its own reason. Many different other sites is an aggregator, not a takeover, and is not held. A small reviewed list of legitimate moves (revues.org to openedition.org) and any confirmed R193 pair do not hold. The housekeeping lane sweeps incrementally (article cursor + a first full pass in slices, no network), and qualification judging holds an off-site candidate instead of stamping it. The Sources tab shows Held with the counts and a visible caveat, and a 'This is the same outlet' button: a logged POST /api/quarantine/host-pairs that re-admits (an append-only confirmed attempt plus an undoable admission event) and lifts the marks; withdrawing the pair holds it again. No re-extraction.
